sections.text: Introduction

This 
document out lines the details the major maintenance procedures P1, which must be 
performed basses on an annually as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block

The Oil or Gas burner 
function to burn the fuel to produce heating.

The first draft initiated by eng: Emad El Din Ali, reviewed by eng. Sadek Massoad, 
tested at 16 March 2004, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Samir Abd El-Gelil, accepted by general manager eng. Mohamed abd El 
Karem Aly, approved by eng. Mokhter Abd Ellatif Wafy Abu Soltan power 
station head sector, 
and certified by eng Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPC inspection and quality control 
head sector
